## About
Our poker club sits on Katy Fwy in Katy, TX. Come in for a cash game, sit down for PLO, or enter one of our tournaments. The doors are open around the clock, every day, so there's a seat whenever you're ready to play.
We want the room to feel like a good place to spend an evening. That means a comfortable room, food and drinks brought to the table, and dealers who keep the game moving. Players have given us a 4.3 rating from 133 reviews on Google.

## Services
- Cash games: Sit down at a cash game any time of day. One reviewer called our cash games fun and our tournaments well structured.
- PLO and tournaments: Along with hold'em, we spread PLO and run tournaments.
- Food and drinks: Order food and drinks without leaving your seat.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: We're open 24 hours a day, every day of the week.

Q: Where are you located?
A: You'll find us on Katy Fwy in Katy, TX.

Q: Can I get something to eat while I play?
A: Yes. We serve food and drinks in the room.

## What customers say
- "This is one of my favorite poker rooms in Texas. It’s classy, fun, good people, and awesome food! I would even put this in my Top 10 for poker rooms in the country. Maybe not Top 5, but in the 6-10 range (of 117).

I always try to mention at least one negative to maintain fair and balanced reviews. One guy that worked here (owner’s brother or something) wasn’t very friendly but manager and owner were great people. And one dealer made a big error (and might have known it), but other than that, awesome dealers!

Overall, the staff and vibe here are freaking awesome! I absolutely 100% recommend 101 Poker. The cash games are fun as hell and the tourneys are well structured and a blast. This is just a feel-good place.

Basically, if you want to have a lot of fun while also having a shot at winning some good money, this is where you go. As for food, it’s tied with Champions for best poker room food I have ever had, which is saying a lot. Ironically, they are both in TX and not Vegas." (Tyler Nals, 5/5)
- "The food is excellent, and the atmosphere is outstanding. Lindsay is an amazing waitress who truly enhances the experience. I always enjoy my time here and appreciate the exceptional service from the entire staff. The dealers are top-notch, and I would highly recommend this place to anyone. The management makes every need that you could imagine happen Jeff is the best manager you could ask for!" (Andy Hagedorn, 5/5)
- "Great place to play Poker, PLO and  tournaments, Great staff, they offer food, drinks, even security while you are there. Lots of action $$$" (Jorge Urdaneta, 5/5)
